subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence for retention change & capacity increase
messages:
From: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@novusbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit-team@novusbank.com
Date: 2025-11-20T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 renewal — evidence for retention window change / capacity increase

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this on. Novus has a SOC 2 renewal kickoff next month and our regulators want a couple of changes documented before we sign the renewal amendment:

1) Log retention: we need confirmation that audit logs for production inference endpoints will be retained for 18 months (current contract has 6 months). Please provide the configuration screenshots or exported policy that controls retention for API request logs and auth events.

2) Evidence bundle: a compact manifest of the artifacts you will hand off (system activity logs, control mappings, change history exports) and an ETA for delivery. We prefer a single compressed archive for the first pass.

3) Capacity/term: we plan to increase committed seats and sustained throughput in Q1 with an associated term amendment — we need a preliminary cost/term quote so procurement can budget.

Can you confirm what you can deliver by Nov 28 and share a meeting slot if you prefer to walk through the artifacts?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Wilson
Director, IT Risk & Audit
Novus Bank

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@novusbank.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-20T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — evidence for retention window change / capacity increase

Sam — thanks, we can support this. High level plan and owners below: 

- Evidence & retention screenshots: Kimberly will export the relevant policy docs and screenshots from our logging service and produce an evidence_manifest (target 11/26). (attachment: evidence_manifest_v1.csv)
- Archive bundle: we'll stage a compressed archive of the control artifacts and a README mapping to SOC 2 criteria (delivery 11/28).
- Capacity/term quote: Ben will produce a two-option proposal (12-mo term vs. 24-mo term) showing committed throughput and unit pricing for the seat uplift — preliminary numbers by 11/24.
- DocuSign & PO path: we'll prepare a draft term amendment for legal review; if acceptable we can route a DocuSign link the week of 11/30.

If it's helpful I can run a 30-min walkthrough the week of 11/24 — proposed time slots: Mon 11/24 10–11am PT or Tue 11/25 2–3pm PT.

Action items: Kimberly (export retention config + screenshots), Ben (pricing + uplift modeling), I will draft the amendment and loop Legal for redlines.

Attachments included in initial reply: evidence_manifest_v1.csv (stub)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-21T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 renewal — evidence for retention window change / capacity increase

Laura — forwarding Novus request. Key asks: extend log retention control to 18 months (contract amendment), provide evidence bundle and screenshots, and include a seat/throughput uplift with two term options.

Requested redline points: 
- A simple term amendment that amends section on "Log Retention" to 18 months for audit logs and defines the delivery cadence for evidence bundles during renewal.
- Add a capacity commit table (committed seats + burst allowances) and how that maps to billing.
- SLA note: confirm any latency/throughput SLA impacts for the increased commit.

Please comment on the attached draft (proposed_term_amendment_draft.pdf) and let us know if Legal needs procurement language for PO vs contract amendment.

Thanks,
Rachel

Rachel,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Novus can do a 30-min walkthrough on Mon 11/24 at 10am PT — that works for our audit lead. A couple of follow-ups: 

- For the retention screenshots, can you include the exact export commands or the UI breadcrumb path so our auditors can reproduce the retrieval?
- Please include a short control mapping doc that ties each artifact in the evidence bundle to the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (CC1.1, CC7.0, etc.) — even a one-paragraph note per artifact is fine.
- For procurement: if you can get the 12-mo vs 24-mo cost comparison to us by 11/24 that will keep our finance team on schedule; otherwise we may need to push the renewal window.

We'll expect the evidence bundle landing page (or shared Drive link) as the first deliverable. If you can share the DocuSign envelope after legal redlines, we will route internally and confirm the PO path.

Thanks — speak Monday.
Sam
